RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel warrants scrutiny given documented gender disparities and implicit bias in academic economics, especially when standard metrics (completed doctorate, publications) favored you. Unconscious homophily could explain weighting "industry experience" over established scholarly output.

However, legitimate non-discriminatory factors frequently sway hiring: department-specific curricular needs, subfield alignment, or interview performance. Additionally, a two-week silence is standard administrative bureaucracy rather than an admission of wrongdoing.

Do not make direct discrimination accusations yet. First, politely follow up regarding your feedback request and verify whether university bylaws mandated gender diversity on the hiring committee. If clear procedural policies were breached or the written explanation contradicts stated criteria, consult an ombudsperson or faculty union confidentially.
